source: World Glacier Monitoring Service, Fluctuations of Glaciers (glaciological series): annual balance from WGMS FoG 2026-02-10 (doi:10.5904/wgms-fog-2026-02-10; data/mass_balance.csv column subset via github.com/ledpup/ClimateExplorer), winter/summer split from the 2022 release via OGGM oggm-sample-data wgms/mbdata
citation: WGMS (2026): Fluctuations of Glaciers Database. World Glacier Monitoring Service, Zurich, Switzerland. doi:10.5904/wgms-fog-2026-02-10
units: m w.e. (metres of water equivalent over the glacier area)
note: Annual balances are the 2026 release, which revised some earlier years (USGS benchmark glaciers recalibrated over their whole record). The winter/summer split is shown only for years whose annual balance is unchanged since the 2022 release; `revised` rows carry the earlier value in annual_prev. Gaps are WGMS's and are not filled.
